label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (insecure-randomness) alert-TP: Math.random() feeds rememberMeKey which becomes a cookie/session ID value - weak RNG for security material. Alert 2 (xss) alert-TP: param from request.getParameter flows to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding - user input reaches HTML output sink. Both alerts are valid vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: Math.random() used to generate rememberMeKey for cookie/session - weak RNG for security-sensitive material
User param concatenated into response.getWriter() output without HTML encoding - XSS sink
